main_text.p: עָרַץ Violentiâ usus fuit, Violenter exagitavit, confregit vel contrivit, Fortem aut Violentum se exhibuit: Expavit, Consternatus fuit: Territ. Infinit. לַעֲרֹץ Ad violenter exagitandum, Psal.10.18. Futur. יַעֲרֹץ Violentiâ usus sim, Job.31.34. תַּעַרְצוּ Expavescite, Deut.20.3. תַּעֲרוּצִי Fortem præbueris te, Jes.47.12. Niph. Particip. נַעֲרָץ Formidabilis, Psalm.89.8. Hiph. Futur. יַעֲרִיצוּ Formidabunt, Jes.29.23. תַּעֲרִיצוּ Formidetis, Jesa.8. v.12.
עָרִיץ masc. Violentus, Tyrannus, Formidabilis: לַעָרִיץ Violento, Job.15.20. Plural. עֲרִיצִים Violenti, Prævalidi, Job.6.23. Constr. עֲרִיצֵי גוֹיִם Violentissimi gentium, Ezech.28.7.
מַעֲרִיץ m. Pavor, Terror; Aff. מַעֲרִיצְכֶם Pavor vester, Jesa.8. v.13.
עָרַק Fugit. Proprie Chaldaicum est: Part. הָעֲרָקִים Qui fugiunt, Job.30.3.
עֲרָקִים m.p. Arteriæ, Nervi: Aff. וְעָרְקַי Et arteriæ meæ, Job.30.17.
עָרִיר m. Solitarius, Ἀτεκνῷ[?] Sine liberis, Gen.15.2. Plural. עֲרִירִים Lev.20.20.
עֶרֶשׂ f. Sponda, Lectus, Psal.41.4. Aff. עַרְשִׂי Spondam meam, Psal.6.7. Plural. עַל עַרְשׂוֹתָם In spondis suis, Amos 6.4.

עֵשֶׂב m. Herba, sativa propriè & culturâ vel ex semine suo rursus proveniens, Gen.1.11. Aff. עִשְׂבָּם Herbam eorum, Jes.42.15. Plur. עִשְׂבוֹת Herba, Prov.27.25. Chald. בְּעִשְׂבָא אַרְעָא In herba terræ, Dan.4.12. וְעִשְׂבָא Et herbam, v.22.

page.notes: Light staining and foxing over the upper left and centre of the page; some letters in the first entry are faint. Hebrew vocalisation in the entries (especially the Chaldee forms and the Greek gloss in the entry עָרִיר) is hard to read at this resolution; the Greek word is uncertain and is marked [?]. Hebrew forms without [?] are copied as seen but should be checked against the original. The first entry's Hebrew headword and the Hebrew in the Niph. and Hiph. forms are the least certain.
